profile.headline: Sr Audio Software Engineer - VPG Audio
profile.summary:
Software Engineer, Project Lead, and Entrepreneur, focused on audio and music software. Experienced in application, framework, plug-in and driver development on desktop, mobile and embedded platforms.

Specialties: Music, Audio, Sound Design, Applications, Plug-ins, Drivers, Real-time Signal Processing, Low-Latency Audio, Cross Platform Frameworks, Recording, Guitar Effects, Synthesis

Audio APIs: UAD, AAX, AU, ASIO, CoreAudio, DirectSound, VST, ReWire, REX
Languages: C++, STL, C, ObjC, Java, JNI
Platforms/Tools: Mac, Windows, iOS, Android, Linux (PREEMPT_RT), Yocto, RTOS, JUCE

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.locationName: Scotts Valley, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Lead SW team that developed UAFX Guitar Pedals and companion desktop and mobile applications.

positions.title: President & CEO / Developer
positions.description: Founder and lead developer of DrumCore AAX/AU/VST plug-in, RiffWorks desktop recording application, FourTrack iOS app,  and GuitarJack Stage and StudioJack Mini USB/Lightning instrument and microphone interface.

positions.title: Adjunct Faculty
positions.description: Instructor of Audio Software Programming in the Digital Audio Technology program. My company, Sonoma Wire Works has employed several Cogswell students and alumni to work in Marketing, Support and Engineering positions. One student from my Spring 2011 porgramming class has been a key contributor to Sonoma Wire Works' GuitarTone iOS App and DrumCore Virtual Instrument plugin and loop library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Engineer on cross-platform framework for audio applications, plug-ins and drivers.

positions.title: Audio Software Engineer
positions.description: Media Team member responsible for Audio Mixer, and Multi-channel Driver processing nodes.

positions.title: Developer Technical Support Engineer
positions.description: Email and phone support for 3rd party developers.  Sales support for evangelists.  Wrote weekly newsletter articles and made presentations at developer conferences.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Testing and developer support for Monster Sound 3D Audio PCI card.

positions.title: Digital Audio Instructor
positions.description: Designed and taught courses in beginning and advanced digital audio production techniques.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description: Maintained 6 classrooms and labs with over 100 computers running multimedia production software.

positions.title: Assistant Recording Engineer
positions.description: Studio recording of independent record projects.

projects.title: UAFX guitar effects pedals
projects.description: Multi-award winning guitar effects and amp-in-a-box pedals

projects.title: GuitarJack audio interface
projects.description: Acclaimed mobile audio recording interface for guitars and microphones. GuitarJack model 1 was the first device powered dock connecting guitar interface for iOS. GuitarJack model 2 improved on the audio performance and added official Made for iPhone status.
